messages:
ben_cs: quick debrief from HelixCardio renewal call — they listed 3 pain points and one wishlist item. posting raw notes:
- Sync job failures around long prompt -> timeouts
- Confusing per-route billing on multi-caller flows
- Embedding drift: older vectors show stale results
Wishlist: per-environment feature flags (dev/stage/prod toggles)
Can we triage and map owners? I'm worried renewal hinges on the billing clarity point. /cc @adele_pm @eric_prodops :exclamation:

adele_pm: thanks — can you paste any exact customer wording? i'll make 1 pager for account execs.

ben_cs: copied verbatim: "billing shows per-route on UI but we get charged per-call; hard to reconcile for usage-based billing" — session id hc-9382

sam_eng: sounds like a mapping mismatch between route_id and billing_rate table. i'll check logs. if true we can add a short-term ETA: patch in 48h. sending logs request now. :wrench:

nia_research: can we add their example prompts to our regression set? embedding drift might be a quality regression. i'll pull 20 examples from their production set — need consent from cs/legal.

eric_prodops: renewal note: if billing clarity unresolved they may ask for a pricing credit. recommend creating canary with clearer UI copy and a one-click export for invoices.

ben_cs: assign: @sam_eng debug billing mapping; @nia_research collect prompts; @adele_pm make exec 1-pager + proposed copy. i'll follow up with customer tomorrow and share refund/credit stance.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: billing_mapping_hotfix -> canary (tags: helixcardio-urgent) — ETA 12:30 UTC

adele_pm: added task list in roadmap board and tagged priority=p0. leaving comments with suggested ui copy and billing-export mock. :thumbsup:

ben_cs: thanks team — will update thread after canary result. keeping renewal owner looped: @eric_prodops
